nodes.label: Unreal Engine concept mapping
nodes.rationale: Manual is written for Unreal users; every feature is named after its Unreal equivalent so existing knowledge transfers.

nodes.label: Level modes (3D Modeling, Foliage, Landscape, Animation Sequence, PCG, VFX, 2D)
Workspaces (Layout, Modeling, Shading, Animation, Scripting, UI, Effects)
nodes.rationale: Blender-style workspace tabs give each job its own panel arrangement while Layout stays the original.

nodes.label: Live editing
nodes.rationale: Edits apply immediately, also in Play; mesh import settings are excluded because reimporting a big mesh while dragging a slider would stall frames.

nodes.label: .meta files and asset GUIDs
nodes.rationale: References point at the GUID, not the file name, so renaming and moving assets keeps references working.

nodes.label: Plain-text assets
nodes.rationale: Levels, graphs, data assets and UI are plain text so they merge and diff in Git.

nodes.label: Git source control in Content Browser
Volumes (Blocking, Kill, Trigger, Audio, Post Process, Nav)
Post Process Volume (ACES, bloom, TAA/FXAA, SSR, SSAO, DOF, auto exposure)
nodes.rationale: Without a volume the level gets a new volume's defaults, as in Unreal, so the default look is good.

nodes.label: Multiplayer (Net Replicated, interpolation, events)
nodes.rationale: Single checkbox; in single player the same calls run locally so one script works both ways. Server routes chat/voice so clients cannot pick listeners.

nodes.label: Build Lighting (light probes, Lightmass Importance Volume)
nodes.rationale: Without baking, Sky Light ambient is uniform so closed rooms are as bright as fields; probes record visible sky and one bounce.

nodes.label: Input Actions and Mapping Contexts (Enhanced Input)
Game Mode and kept tables (game_instance, player_state, subsystem)
Physics (Jolt: Rigid Body, Physics Joint, traces)
Lua scripting (Script component, sandbox)
nodes.rationale: Scripts run sandboxed (no io, os.execute, FFI, bytecode) for safety; save data goes through lsd.save_game.

nodes.label: Claude MCP plugin (lsd_mcp)
nodes.rationale: Bridge sends each tool call as a console line over 127.0.0.1 (same channel as Remote Console); local only and editor-only for safety.

nodes.label: My Blueprint panel, Collapse to Function, Palette
LOD screen sizes, Max Draw Distance, Cull Distance Volume
Unreal rigs and retargeting (UE4 Mannequin, UE5 Manny)
nodes.rationale: Retarget on import as rotation change from rest pose so animations play across UE4/UE5 rigs; pelvis movement scaled by height.

nodes.label: Morph targets
nodes.rationale: Mixed on the CPU when a weight changes; fine for a few faces, not crowds.

nodes.label: Audio (Sound, Sound Cue, Sound Class, Mix, Attenuation, Occlusion)
Particle Systems (emitters, Over Life, renderers, collision)
Navmesh, Nav Agent, Nav Modifier Volume
Behavior Trees, Blackboard, decorators, services
nodes.rationale: Decorators and services are nodes with one child that wrap it, instead of Unreal's attachments.

nodes.label: Game UI (RmlUi HTML/CSS, UI window, designer canvas)
nodes.rationale: Designer writes into the document as inline style and attributes so code and canvas always agree.

nodes.label: UI document's own JavaScript (ui.* API)
nodes.rationale: Keeps UI-only logic with the UI; functions over half a second are stopped so loops cannot freeze the game.

nodes.label: Profiling (stat unit, stat dump, Tracy, memreport)

hyperedges.label: Gameplay languages sharing the lsd API and script events
Ways to add visual script nodes (ScriptNode, C/C++, JavaScript)
AI stack: navmesh, behaviour trees, perception
